gate: No held-out gate beyond the exploratory evidence; membership and fusion rule fixed before any test run.
one_variable: prediction-level ensemble with fixed membership: V2-WS2.0, V2HO-HO0GC-s17, V2HO-KF64-s17, V2HO-TK1-s17 and V2HO-NOACTX-s17 (every UCF101-24 model of this recipe family available on 2026-09-26; the four V2HO models were trained without groups 22-25). Each is evaluated once on split-1 test with the frozen protocol; frame detections are fused by tools/fuse_model_views.py (scores averaged over the five, a missing model counting 0; boxes score-weighted; IoU 0.55; NMS 0.5). Video: tubes fused with the rule chosen by V2HO-TUBEFUSE2 if it passes its check, else the video numbers stay V2-WS2.0's.
purpose: Exploratory held-out evidence (2026-09-26, three models, disclosed): fusing KF64, TK1 and NOACTX raised annotated-frame VOC by +0.37 and every-frame VOC by +0.40-0.44 over their mean on both tune and confirm. No member is chosen by any test result.
test_use: Evaluated on split-1 test once; reported as a separate 'ensemble of 5' row. The single-model numbers stay the headline. The four V2HO members were registered with no test use; this separate use is disclosed in their notes and in the paper.
